subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt all five public memory role slots with per-agent overrides now, including roles whose richer invocation protocols remain future work?
rationale: The implementation can be technically correct while the breadth, naming, migration window, and long-term plugin contract still require explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt all five roles
options.body: Approve the full role model and per-agent overrides, then require current-head compatibility and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Land only roles with mature invocation contracts and defer the remaining role or per-agent surfaces.

options.title: Use another composition seam
options.body: Pause this PR and design capability or orchestration APIs instead of durable public slot keys.

recommendation.title: Adopt all five roles
recommendation.body: Approve the full role model and per-agent overrides, then require current-head compatibility and real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest shared history across the central plugin, memory runtime, dreaming, and UI surfaces and is the best available owner for the durable product/API choice.
